facts.fact: Father X 借死去的 Seine 之口重现湖边记忆：一个男性声音（Benjamin 猜是 Mooch 的某个哥哥）提议「那我们可以把他扔进湖里？」，年轻的 Seine 反问「苹果会浮吗？」——当年少年 Benjamin 确实被他们扔进了冰冷的 Lower Two Medicine 湖，湿淋淋爬上岸后自问「Am I Blackfeet now?」，此后一直在问自己这个问题。
facts.anchor: “So we can dunk him in the lake, then?” the male voice, one of Mooch’s older brothers probably, asked, a certain suggestiveness to his tone, like there was some eye contact going on.

facts.fact: 附在 Seine 尸体上的 Father X 用她被剥了皮的右手把「脑髓绳」从裹尸布上收起，隔着床递向 Benjamin 引他尝，说「Penny for her thoughts」，并点明那晚她在远处看着她「吓坏了的小表亲」——Seine 是 Benjamin 的表亲（cousin）。
facts.anchor: “Penny for her thoughts,” it said, chuckling. “Was she still there that night, watching her scared little cousin from so far away?”

facts.fact: Christian 循着手中破损后视镜（像罗盘/Magic 8 Ball 一样指引）走到抽油烟机前，从高处取下一团灰色口香糖状物（Father X 的藏身处）吞进自己嘴里，嘴里同时响起七声（seven tinks）如机关启动般的 tink 声。
facts.anchor: He then guided that wad of gum directly into his open, waiting mouth.

facts.fact: 吞下灰团后 Christian 吼出「ENOUGH!」，力道令 RV 内气压胀缩、仿佛整个现实随之脉动；Father X 尖叫着把脸转开，Seine 的身体随即瘫软——Nate 抓住 Christian 的手臂摇晃祝贺「You did it」，驱魔成功，Mooch 从背后抱住 Christian。
facts.anchor: “ENOUGH!” he bellowed as clearly as any word had ever been said, and with more force than Benjamin would have guessed one person could have.

facts.fact: 谈到来历时 Nate 说那东西出现在「Marias 事件十年后（Ten years after Marias）」，Benjamin 纠正为「更像九年半（More like nine and a half）」——即 Carlisle 印第安工业学校的第一个年头，也是他要把那男孩从中救出的东西。
facts.anchor: “More like nine and a half,” Benjamin corrected. “That’s the first year of Carlisle Indian Industrial School. It’s what I’m saving him from.”

facts.fact: 在 Alzada 的 B&J's 加油站加油后不到四分之一英里，Christian 把车停进一处废弃路肩弃尸：三人把用毯子和床单裹成茧的 Seine 抬下车，靠放在倒塌的木托盘堆上、背对公路；Christian 说「鸟会找到她（the birds will find her）」，随后 RV 驶离。
facts.anchor: They worked her the rest of the short way down the aisle, made the turn out the door, sat her down against the pallets with her back to the road.

facts.fact: 夜里 RV 被「night crossing」拦停：四十至五十头牛（forty or fifty head of cattle）被赶着横穿公路，牛眼在车灯下泛绿光；赶牛的是个银色长辫、牛仔裤褪色的印第安牛仔，向挡风玻璃抬手行脱帽礼——Mooch 冲出车追他而去，Christian 没有停车，把她留在了夜里。
facts.anchor: It was a night crossing: forty or fifty head of cattle being herded from one side of the road to the other, their eye shine glinting green in the headlights, the red glow on their hides putting Benjamin in mind of the Fourth of July.

facts.fact: Benjamin 把 Seine 的呓语逐音节听写、再把抄下的字母倒序重排，发现不是乱码而是倒着说的同一句话；Nate 拿起笔记本读出「Look. Out. The. Window.」——此刻一辆白色半挂与 RV 完全并行驶过，其 logo 是一只被切去一块、露出白色果肉的红苹果。
facts.anchor: “Look. Out. The. Window,” the kid read, sounding the words out.
